$comment: Schema v2. Version-agnostic pattern database for scan_notebook.py. Each entry carries a LIFECYCLE ({introduced, deprecated, superseded, removed}) as strict version strings (parsed by mesa_versions.parse_version; prose is a hard load-time error). The scanner COMPUTES a status at the --target: not-yet-introduced (API newer than target) > removed (errors at target) > deprecated (warns at target) > legacy (silently superseded, slated for removal) > current. There is no materialized status. Lifecycle stamps are empirically verified (see scripts note): probed on mesa 2.3.4/3.0.3/3.1.5/3.2.0/3.3.1/3.4.2/3.5.1. Mesa-4 removals use removed:'4.0.0a0' so a 4.0.0a0 target computes them removed. Field semantics: kind = api|prose|install (default api). judge:true = surface the hit for human check even when computed status is current. applicable_min/applicable_max = the entry's CONCERN only exists in [min,max) (opposite polarity to API existence; e.g. reserved-name assignment only harms >=3.0.0). by_target = [{min,max,replacement,note,status}] band overrides, first match wins (min incl, max excl). replacement may contain {TARGET}. For old-API entries replacement is the forward fix; for anachronism (not-yet-introduced) entries it is the target-era form (the downgrade/don't-overshoot work list). Every hit is fixed or explicitly judged a false positive in the report — never skipped silently. When Mesa releases a new version, extend this file together with version-catalog.json and version-history.md (see SKILL.md 'Maintaining the version history').

entries.note: Verified empirically on 3.5.1: AgentSet.__getitem__ is DEPRECATED (removed 4.0) but the warning is a PendingDeprecationWarning that fires only on DERIVED AgentSets (results of select()/shuffle()/explicit AgentSet(...)); the top-level model.agents[i] is SILENT (its type _HardKeyAgentSet is not an AgentSet subclass). Fix to .to_list()[i] regardless — it is a Mesa-4 removal. agents_by_type[SomeClass] is dict access and CURRENT — do not flag. Pattern keys on `.agents[` only (so a plain list stored from `.to_list()`, e.g. `agents = self.agents.to_list(); agents[0]`, is NOT flagged — index it freely). Derived AgentSets are not regex-visible — check in the semantic pass. CURRENT at targets ≤3.4.
